text:
chris: FYI planning a small prod release tomorrow 09:00 PT. Changes are adaptive-batching tweaks + prometheus label fix. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, and CS/marketing blurb. Plan: canary 10% for 10m, then full rollout if green.

ana: I can own the CS/marketing side. Will draft a short ops note + customer-facing bullets. Send me the 2–3 impact lines by EOD. :+1:

sam: I'll take deploy ownership and do the canary. Deploy steps (brief):
```
# merge main -> prod
git checkout main && git pull
git tag -a v1.42.0 -m "release v1.42.0"
./scripts/deploy --tag v1.42.0 --env prod --strategy canary --percent 10
```
Will run health checks after canary and promote to 100% if no errors.

rachel: CS will prep support playbook. I'll make a short triage flow: how to check logs, how to run the smoke script, and rollback steps. Put the exact commands here and I'll paste into the doc.

sam: Smoke checklist (to run after canary shift):
1) curl -f https://api.redwood.example.com/health || fail
2) run smoke script: `./scripts/smoke_test.sh --profile prod` (should return 0)
3) run 3 sample prompts to verify latency and correctness (see test prompts in repo/tests/smoke_prompts.txt)
4) check prometheus: `sum(rate(request_errors_total[5m]))` should be ~0

chris: Rollback command if needed:
```
# rollback to previous image
./scripts/deploy --tag v1.41.7 --env prod --strategy immediate
```
We expect rollback to finish within ~3m. Sam — can you confirm you have perms to re-promote old image?

sam: Confirmed, I do. I'll also open a short runbook in the release doc and pin it.

mohit: Marketing — I'll prepare the release microcopy for the blog + product changelog. Need one-sentence summary + 3 bullets about user impact. Ana, Rachel: can you share the bullets once final?

chris: Timing constraints: code freeze at 08:00 PT tomorrow, tag by 08:15, deploy at 09:00. If any blocker shows up before 08:30 we pull. Please post thumbs-up in this thread when you're set.

ana: CS/marketing will be ready. I'll send the staged customer blurb by 17:00 today.

rachel: Support playbook ready draft — will share in #support channel after you tag. Also adding quick triage checklist and who to page (oncall + sam).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for v1.42.0 at 1718290800 (09:00 PT). Canary 10% for 10m. Automatic promote to 100% if no errors exceed threshold.

chris: Great. Quick confirmations — sam (deploy owner), ana (CS/marketing), rachel (support/playbook), mohit (marketing copy). React with :thumbsup: when you can make the window.

sam: :thumbsup:

ana: :thumbsup:

rachel: :thumbsup:

mohit: :thumbsup:

chris: locking this. I'll post final release notes here after tag.
